name: home
description: The app's home page as a place plugins put their widgets: a plugin registers a widget in ctx.effect, the page renders it, and it leaves with the plugin.
mount: a row `- id: home` / `name: home` before the routes row in blend.yaml; the routes render renderWidgets(ctx.home) on the home page; a plugin does ctx.effect(() => ctx.home.widget({ id, title, render }))
